fuse_elevation — DRIVE walkterrain op

• Data kinds: images → depth

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.fuse_elevation(grids, agg: 'str' = 'max') (to call the implementation directly, import terrain; terrain.fuse_elevation(grids, agg: 'str' = 'max'); from the registry, opsdrive.get("fuse_elevation"))

• GPU: none (CPU reference implementation only)

Usage

Fuse several aligned elevation grids into one robot-centric map.

Multi-frame accumulation: as a robot walks it sees the terrain from several depth frames; binning each into an elevation_map on a common grid and fusing them here fills gaps and firms up heights. agg = 'max' (obstacle-safe, default), 'min' (ground-safe) or 'mean'. nan (unobserved in a given frame) is ignored; a cell unobserved in *every* frame stays nan. Input grids must share a shape.
